candidates.explanation: When no provider is supplied, the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google instead of AuthProvidersEnum.email. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then rejects them with `needLoginViaProvider:google` because their provider isn't 'email'.
Register doesn't pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email on line 126 instead of google. Optionally, also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
